_comment: Single source of truth for this repository's Zenodo identifiers.
The repository is published and the status and DOI values below are live. Update them by
running scripts/set_doi.py — do not hand-edit the DOI strings in README.md / CITATION.cff /
CHANGELOG.md / DOI_PENDING.md / docs/predecessors/README.md, because the carriers have to stay
in step and hand-editing is how they drift apart.
See DOI_PENDING.md for how the v4.0.1 deposit was made.
_version_note: The release version is NOT duplicated here. .zenodo.json owns it, scripts/cut_release.sh
checks it against CITATION.cff and CHANGELOG.md, and a second copy in this file would be
one more place for the three of them to disagree. Read it from .zenodo.json.
note_on_predecessor_doi: Until 2026-10-04 the associated manuscript's Data availability statement cited 10.5281/zenodo.22910500 / .22910501, which resolve to wu-yijing/eqtl-source-discordance-audit v1.0.0 (2026-09-23) — a 2.34 MB snapshot that predates every gap closure in metadata/ARCHIVE_MAP.md, the committed figure build outputs and the SI ACAT-O rule. The v4.0.1 deposit of this repository closed that mismatch: the statement now cites this repository's own DOIs.
